descriptionChirho: Abstract noun denoting the office, dignity, or authority of a king; kingship, royal rule, royalty. Used of Saul's kingship (1 Sam 10:16, 25; 11:14; 14:47), the transfer of the kingdom from Saul to David (1 Sam 18:8; 2 Sam 12:26; 1 Kgs 1:46; 2:15, 22; 11:35; 12:21), the royal line or dynasty (2 Kgs 25:25; Jer 41:1; Ezek 17:13; Dan 1:3), and God's universal kingship (Ps 22:28; Isa 62:3; Obad 1:21). All occurrences share the single core meaning of regal authority or kingly office, whether with article, preposition, or in construct.
